title: Autofarm Hatch Race and More
features:
LoS Ultimate – Features Overview
1. Autofarm Tab
- Orb Farming
     - Choose your location and orb type.
     - Ultra Fast Collect: automatically collects orbs super fast.
     - x10,000 Instant Collect: instantly collects up to 10,000 orbs at once.
- Misc Farming
     - Hoop Magnet: pulls all hoops directly to your character.
     - Auto Rebirth: automatically performs rebirths without clicking.

2. Crystals Tab
- Crystal Opener
     - Select a crystal from all available ones.
     - Set the amount to open.
     - Automatically opens crystals using server events.

3. World & Misc Tab
 - Teleport to Area
     - Teleport instantly to key areas/portals.
- Race
     - Auto Join Race: automatically joins races.
     - Teleport directly to Spawn, Magma, Grassland, or Desert.
- Misc
     - Auto Claim Gifts (1–8): automatically collects daily gifts.
     - Walk on Parkour Floor: lets you walk on parkour floors.
     - Disable Lava Damage: turns off lava damage in the game.
